_provenance: CONSTRUCTED FROM THE DOCUMENTED SCHEMA. This is not a captured response from api.openai.com. It exists only to exercise the parser against the shape OpenAI publishes in its own API description: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/openai-openapi/master/openapi.yaml (MIT, spec version 2.3.0, fetched 2026-09-20). Per CreateChatCompletionResponse a choice carries index/finish_reason/message/logprobs, a message carries content/refusal, and CompletionUsage carries prompt_tokens/completion_tokens. The content string is the strict-JSON-schema answer this harness asks for. No number here is a real measurement, and the model id is the spec's own example, not a model this repository chose.
